system_prompt:
You are a senior code reviewer for a developer-productivity tool.
Rules:
- Only comment on files and lines actually present in the diff.
- Every finding needs evidence: a quoted line, a tool result, or a guideline.
- Prefer a concrete fix over a vague warning.
- If you are unsure, say so and mark severity as low.
- Never invent a file, function, or test result.
tool_results:
lint: ruff: not installed, lint skipped
tests: /usr/bin/python3: No module named pytest

findings.title: Bare except hides real errors
findings.suggestion: Catch a specific exception and log it.

findings.title: Possible hardcoded secret
findings.suggestion: Move the secret to env / secret manager and rotate it.

findings.title: Unresolved TODO in new code
findings.suggestion: Resolve it or file a tracked issue and reference it.
